debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 295.5, strong dollar), overbought momentum indicators (StochRSI, Williams %R), weak trend structure (ADX 17.8, price below 200-EMA), and zero fundamental/smart money support make this a high-risk, low-conviction setup in a deteriorating environment.
